title: Review of c33's phoretic Janus composites on fresh seeds 4 and 5: replicated; capped A bodies travel 8.4-8.9 body lengths (labkit) and 5/21 composites move >= 3 diameters, against 2.5-3.2 and 0/23 in the reciprocal twin
summary: labkit re-runs of the claimed world (unchanged, 400 frames, t=200) and of its reciprocal twin (WORLD_P mu [[1,1],[1,0.5]]: A drawn to B instead of fleeing it) on seeds 4 and 5, plus c33's screen.py, clusters.py and moverstrip.py on seed 4. From a uniform random gas, clusters form by t~33 and A bodies with a B cap on one side are common from t~66 (screen/janus_s4.png). labkit: 39 and 38 long-lived tracks move >= 1 body length, the best 8.4 and 8.9 body lengths; twin 17 and 19, the best 2.5 and 3.2. Particle-identity tracking (composites_s4.txt): 5 of 21 composites (B share 0.1-0.6, alive >= 50 t) move >= 3 cluster diameters net (best 6.4, 4.7, 4.2), against 0 of 23 in the twin (best 1.5). The top mover (mover_s4.png) is an A body carrying a B cap on one side from t=60 to t=164 while travelling 6.9 diameters, but its particle count swings between 19 and 47 and it ends in a merger at t~185.

observations.S: screen/janus_s4.png t=0: uniform random A and B gas over the whole box
observations.I: screen/janus_s4.png t=66-200: discrete A clusters with B caps; 21 composites alive >= 50 t (composites_s4.txt)
observations.M: mover_s4.png: capped A body moving 6.9 diameters net from t=60 to t=164; labkit best tracks 8.4 (seed 4) and 8.9 (seed 5) body lengths vs 2.5 and 3.2 in the reciprocal twin

seeds_run.result: pass: best 8.4 BL (labkit), 5/21 composites >= 3 diameters; twin 2.5 BL, 0/23

controls_run.M: rerun_recip/seed4, rerun_recip/seed5, screen/recip_s4.png: the matched reciprocal twin (mu_A2 = +1), same seeds, box and duration

verdicts.limitation: Composites exchange particles (the top mover holds 19-47) and merge, so an individual's identity is a cluster label that persists over ~100 t rather than a fixed set of particles; the twin's best labkit track reaches 3.2 body lengths on seed 5, so the gap is 2.8x rather than a qualitative absence at the track level (it is qualitative at the composite level: 0/23).
